svg.aria-label: Breadboard internal connections: the long plus and minus rails run the full length of each edge; the short columns in the middle are joined in groups of five holes; the centre groove breaks the connection between the top and bottom halves.
svg.title: D-3.1 — Breadboard internal connections
svg.desc: A top-down schematic of a standard 830-point breadboard. Top and bottom edges show the long power rails (red plus, black minus) running the full length. The main field shows columns of five holes connected vertically by hidden metal strips. The centre groove separates the top half from the bottom half. One column is highlighted to show the group-of-five connection.
svg.text: D-3.1 — How a breadboard is wired inside
Two long rails per edge run the full length. The middle columns are joined in groups of 5. The centre groove breaks the top and bottom halves apart.

g.text: — one strip from left side to right side.
The centre groove breaks the columns
— top half and bottom half do NOT touch.
